countRules.publisherAuthority: Count the named publisher or government issuing authority once. SCZN3 is a custodian/authority owner for a preserved representation, not an additional product publisher. USMC counts because it issued procedure evidence even though no exact product was established.
countRules.product: Count a commercial SKU or government form/NSN once. Exclude the SCZN3 reference representation, the Army configuration-overlay relationship, and the USMC procedure-only evidence because they are not separate commercial/government products.
countRules.physicalFace: Count every printed side of each substantiated product. A claimed two-sided product counts as two faces even when one side's design is unresolved.
countRules.representation: Count every stable product-face representation record separately unless preserved evidence proves exact duplicate printing. Ink, branding, or unresolved side identity remains separate; the exact real-world unique-design count stays unproven while any side is unresolved.
countRules.geometry: Count cataloged physical-geometry identities/candidates, not artwork. Because several products lack measured physical scale, the exact number of truly unique industry geometries is UNPROVEN; no unresolved candidates are merged merely to force a smaller number.
countRules.procedure: Count stable governed/evidence-defined procedures and explicit unresolved procedure buckets separately. Do not infer a procedure from geometry or product naming.
countRules.family: Count the nine candidate geometry/procedure families in the M/FAM authority registry.
countRules.runtimeBinding: Count only explicit GOVERNED Target Profile bindings.
